title_zh: 百年京张 AI 创新带 · 14 张 AI 场景卡
title_en: Centennial Jingzhang AI Belt · 14 AI Scenario Cards

status_legend.conceptual: 概念性：场景设计为概念建议，须经专业团队与试点授权后落地，非已确定工程。
status_legend.industry_test: 产业实测：可在受控沙箱/授权数据下开展可复现实验的产业级场景。

privacy_principle: 所有场景遵循『公开—授权—脱敏—人工复核』四级处理；凡涉及个人、企业、治理或医疗数据的环节，默认最小必要、不出域、可审计、可退出。
human_review_rule: 标注『人工复核：必』的场景，任何对外输出（发布、控制、干预、决策建议）前须经授权人员确认；标注『部分』的环节在异常/边界情形触发人工复核。
global_note: 本文件为概念性设计交付，所有落点（NODE-xx）基于临时边界示意，待官方 SITE_BOUNDARY 公布后重定位；所有 KPI 为设计目标值，非实测承诺。

cards.service_object_zh: AI 工程师 / 高校团队 / 创业者
cards.privacy_boundary_zh: 公开数据集 + 行业脱敏样本；原始数据不出域
cards.privacy_boundary_en: Public datasets + desensitized industry samples; raw data stays in-domain
cards.operator_zh: 国智平台 / 开放城市 AI

fields.data_input_zh: 公开数据集 + 行业脱敏样本；模型权重/评测集经授权接入，原始数据不出域。
fields.data_input_en: Public datasets + desensitized industry samples; authorized model weights/benchmarks, raw data in-domain.
fields.system_boundary_zh: 仅服务模型训练—中试—评测闭环，不直连城市运行系统；算力与数据通过沙箱隔离。
fields.system_boundary_en: Serves only the train-pilot-evaluate loop; no direct link to city-operations systems; compute & data sandboxed.
fields.model_capability_zh: 支持多模态模型微调、蒸馏与开源权重发布；内置评测基线。
fields.model_capability_en: Multimodal fine-tuning, distillation, open-weight release; built-in eval baselines.
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 企业/高校提交中试申请 → 人工复核（必）→ 分配算力配额。
fields.trigger_condition_en: Enterprise/university submits pilot request → mandatory human review → compute quota assigned.
fields.service_flow_zh: 申请 → 合规审查 → 沙箱训练 → 自动评测 → 开源发布 / 驳回。
fields.service_flow_en: Apply → compliance review → sandbox training → auto-eval → open release / reject.
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 算力波动时降级为排队重试；评测异常时冻结发布并人工复核；数据泄露风险触发熔断。
fields.failure_degradation_en: On volatility: queue-retry; on eval anomaly: freeze release + human review; on leak risk: circuit-break.
fields.measurable_kpi_zh: 中试周期 ≤ 14 天/单任务；评测可复现率 ≥ 95%；开源发布合规率 100%。
fields.measurable_kpi_en: Pilot cycle ≤ 14 days/task; eval reproducibility ≥ 95%; open-release compliance 100%.
fields.spatial_facility_zh: 中试工场（≥2,000 m²）、算力机房、开源发布厅、人工复核工位。
fields.spatial_facility_en: Pilot hall (≥2,000 m²), compute room, open-release hall, human-review desks.

cards.reproducible_protocol_zh: 基线 = 同一公开评测集 + 固定随机种子；记录环境/数据版本/超参；保存期限 = 评测日志脱敏后留存 180 天；人工决策点 = 发布前合规复核；退出机制 = 项目结束 30 天内销毁副本。
cards.reproducible_protocol_en: Baseline = same public eval set + fixed seed; log env/data version/hyperparams; retention = desensitized eval logs 180 days; human gate = pre-release compliance; exit = destroy copies within 30 days.

cards.privacy_boundary_zh: 匿名轨迹；仅分析不干预
cards.privacy_boundary_en: Anonymous traces; analysis only, no intervention

fields.data_input_zh: 匿名化出行轨迹、道路网与过街设施台账（均脱敏、聚合到路段级）。
fields.data_input_en: Anonymized mobility traces, road network & crossing inventory (desensitized, aggregated to segment level).
fields.system_boundary_zh: 仅做断点识别与优先级排序，不直接控制信号或施工；输出为建议清单。
fields.system_boundary_en: Gap identification & prioritization only; no direct control of signals or works; outputs are advisory lists.
fields.model_capability_zh: 轨迹聚类、断点评分、改善优先级排序。
fields.model_capability_en: Trace clustering, gap scoring, improvement prioritization.
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 持续采集（授权匿名）→ 周级重算 → 异常自动标记。
fields.trigger_condition_en: Continuous collection (authorized, anonymous) → weekly recompute → auto-flag anomalies.
fields.service_flow_zh: 采集 → 脱敏 → 断点评分 → 人工抽检（部分）→ 形成改善工单。
fields.service_flow_en: Collect → desensitize → gap score → manual spot-check → improvement tickets.
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 样本不足时降级为人工巡查清单；误判由人工复核纠偏。
fields.failure_degradation_en: On low sample: fall back to manual patrol list; misclassifications corrected by human review.
fields.measurable_kpi_zh: 断点修复率、慢行连通指数年提升 ≥ 10%。
fields.measurable_kpi_en: Gap-fix rate; walkability connectivity index +≥10% YoY.
fields.spatial_facility_zh: 慢行节点屏、绿脉驿站数据终端。
fields.spatial_facility_en: Slow-mobility node screens, greenway data kiosks.

cards.service_object_zh: 老龄居民 / 慢性病患者
cards.privacy_boundary_zh: 严格授权；医疗数据专域、不出域
cards.privacy_boundary_en: Strict consent; medical data in dedicated domain, never leaves

fields.data_input_zh: 用户授权后的健康档案摘要、可穿戴体征（脱敏）、用药与随访记录。
fields.data_input_en: User-authorized health summary, wearable vitals (desensitized), medication & follow-up records.
fields.system_boundary_zh: 提供提醒、初筛建议与转诊引导，不诊断、不开方；所有医疗结论须医生确认。
fields.system_boundary_en: Reminders, triage suggestions, referral guidance; no diagnosis/prescription; all medical conclusions require a physician.
fields.model_capability_zh: 体征趋势预警、用药提醒、跌倒风险初筛、复诊调度。
fields.model_capability_en: Vital-trend alerting, medication reminder, fall-risk screening, revisit scheduling.
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 用户授权建档 → 体征越阈或周期到点 → 人工（医护）复核（必）。
fields.trigger_condition_en: User consents to profile → vitals breach or schedule hit → mandatory clinician review.
fields.service_flow_zh: 建档授权 → 监测 → 预警 → 医护复核 → 转诊/随访。
fields.service_flow_en: Consent profile → monitor → alert → clinician review → referral/follow-up.
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 设备离线转人工电话随访；误报由医护确认后消除。
fields.failure_degradation_en: On device offline: manual phone follow-up; false alerts cleared by clinician.
fields.measurable_kpi_zh: 服务覆盖人群、预警准确率 ≥ 90%、误报率 ≤ 5%。
fields.measurable_kpi_en: Covered population; alert precision ≥ 90%; false-alarm rate ≤ 5%.
fields.spatial_facility_zh: 健康驿站（适老化）、隐私诊室、远程会诊角。
fields.spatial_facility_en: Health station (age-friendly), privacy room, tele-consult corner.

cards.privacy_boundary_zh: 能源数据聚合；不参与业务数据
cards.privacy_boundary_en: Aggregated energy data; no business data involved

fields.data_input_zh: 园区能源台账、光伏/储能遥测（聚合、匿名）、算力负载。
fields.data_input_en: Park energy ledger, PV/storage telemetry (aggregated, anonymous), compute load.
fields.system_boundary_zh: 优化算力调度与能效，电网侧运行，不接触业务数据。
fields.system_boundary_en: Optimizes compute scheduling & efficiency on the grid side; no access to business data.
fields.model_capability_zh: 负载预测、绿电匹配、PUE 优化。
fields.model_capability_en: Load forecasting, green-power matching, PUE optimization.
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 负载/电价/绿电信号变化 → 自动调度；越限人工确认。
fields.trigger_condition_en: Load/price/green-power signals change → auto-schedule; out-of-band → human confirm.
fields.service_flow_zh: 采集 → 预测 → 调度 → 报表。
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 断电由电网协同降级；节点离线跳过并告警。
fields.failure_degradation_en: On outage: grid-coordinated degradation; offline node skipped + alerted.
fields.spatial_facility_zh: 算力驿站、储能柜、能效监测屏。
fields.spatial_facility_en: Compute post, storage cabinet, efficiency monitor.

cards.service_object_zh: 全球开发者 / 开源社区

fields.data_input_zh: 公开发布物料、版本与许可证元数据。
fields.data_input_en: Public release assets, version & license metadata.
fields.system_boundary_zh: 全球直播与发布，内容经中立审核，不托管私有代码。
fields.system_boundary_en: Global livestream & release; neutral review; no private code hosted.
fields.model_capability_zh: 发布编排、多语字幕、许可证合规检查。
fields.model_capability_en: Release orchestration, multilingual captions, license-compliance check.
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 社区提交发布 → 中立审核（部分）→ 排期直播。
fields.trigger_condition_en: Community submits release → neutral review → scheduled livestream.
fields.service_flow_zh: 提交 → 审核 → 直播/归档 → 指标看板。
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 直播中断转录播；审核争议由基金会裁定。
fields.failure_degradation_en: On stream failure: switch to recording; disputes adjudicated by foundation.
fields.measurable_kpi_zh: 年度发布数、社区覆盖国家数。
fields.spatial_facility_zh: 发布厅、同传间、开源档案墙。
fields.spatial_facility_en: Launch hall, interpretation booth, OSS archive wall.

fields.data_input_zh: 算力节点遥测（聚合、匿名）、评测任务日志。
fields.data_input_en: Compute-node telemetry (aggregated, anonymous), benchmark task logs.
fields.system_boundary_zh: 仅评测算力调度与能效，不托管业务数据。
fields.system_boundary_en: Benchmarks only scheduling & efficiency; no business data hosted.
fields.model_capability_zh: 算力调度优化、能效基准评测、故障预测。
fields.model_capability_en: Scheduling optimization, efficiency benchmarking, fault prediction.
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 平台方提交评测任务 → 人工复核（必）→ 分配评测窗口。
fields.trigger_condition_en: Platform submits task → mandatory human review → benchmark window assigned.
fields.service_flow_zh: 接入 → 基准测试 → 能效评分 → 发布榜单/报告。
fields.service_flow_en: Onboard → baseline test → efficiency score → publish leaderboard/report.
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 节点离线时跳过并告警；评分异常触发复测；断电由电网协同降级。
fields.failure_degradation_en: Offline node skipped + alerted; anomalous score → retest; outage grid-coordinated.
fields.measurable_kpi_zh: 评测覆盖节点 ≥ 80%；能效评分可复现误差 ≤ 5%；报告准时率 ≥ 98%。
fields.measurable_kpi_en: Nodes covered ≥ 80%; efficiency-score reproducibility error ≤ 5%; report on-time ≥ 98%.
fields.spatial_facility_zh: 评测机房、能效监测中心、行业发布空间。
fields.spatial_facility_en: Benchmark room, efficiency center, industry release space.

cards.reproducible_protocol_zh: 基线 = 标准算力基准套件 + 固定负载；记录硬件/固件版本；保存期限 = 评测日志脱敏留存 120 天；人工决策点 = 榜单发布前复核；退出机制 = 任务结束 7 天内归档。
cards.reproducible_protocol_en: Baseline = standard suite + fixed load; log hw/fw versions; retention = desensitized logs 120 days; human gate = pre-leaderboard review; exit = archive within 7 days.

cards.privacy_boundary_zh: 用户授权画像；个人域最小必要

fields.data_input_zh: 用户授权的生活偏好、日程、服务订阅。
fields.data_input_en: User-authorized lifestyle preferences, schedule, service subscriptions.
fields.system_boundary_zh: 个人域助手，仅聚合与提醒，不对外披露个人信息。
fields.system_boundary_en: Personal-domain assistant; aggregation & reminders only; no external disclosure.
fields.model_capability_zh: 日程协调、服务推荐、应急联络。
fields.model_capability_en: Schedule coordination, service recommendation, emergency contact.
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 用户主动授权 → 事件触发 → 异常转人工。
fields.trigger_condition_en: User opts in → event triggers → anomalies to human.
fields.service_flow_zh: 授权 → 偏好学习 → 主动提醒 → 人工兜底。
fields.service_flow_en: Authorize → preference learn → proactive reminder → human fallback.
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 推荐失效转人工客服；隐私争议一键退出并销毁。
fields.failure_degradation_en: On rec failure: human support; privacy dispute → one-click exit & destroy.
fields.measurable_kpi_zh: 服务响应时长、用户满意度。

fields.data_input_zh: 脱敏成果摘要、需求清单、对接记录。
fields.data_input_en: Desensitized outcome summaries, demand lists, matchmaking records.
fields.system_boundary_zh: 撮合与展示，不代行知识产权处置；利益申报强制。
fields.system_boundary_en: Matchmaking & showcase; no IP dispossession; interest disclosure mandatory.
fields.model_capability_zh: 成果—需求匹配、转化路径推荐。
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 双方提交 → 匹配 → 线下对接（人工主持）。
fields.service_flow_zh: 入库 → 匹配 → 对接 → 跟踪。
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 匹配偏差由人工协调；冲突申报触发回避。
fields.failure_degradation_en: On mismatch: human coordination; conflict disclosure triggers recusal.
fields.measurable_kpi_zh: 年度转化数、对接成功率。
fields.spatial_facility_zh: 转化客厅、路演角、洽谈室。
fields.spatial_facility_en: Translation lounge, pitch corner, meeting room.

fields.data_input_zh: 合规申报、模型卡/数据卡摘要（脱敏）、投诉记录。
fields.data_input_en: Compliance filings, model/data card summaries (desensitized), complaint records.
fields.system_boundary_zh: 监测与公示，不直接执法；处置建议送监管人工确认。
fields.system_boundary_en: Monitoring & disclosure; no direct enforcement; dispositions sent to regulator for confirmation.
fields.model_capability_zh: 合规态势感知、风险分级、公示生成。
fields.model_capability_en: Compliance situational awareness, risk tiering, disclosure generation.
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 申报/投诉接入 → 风险分级 → 人工复核（必）→ 公示/转办。
fields.trigger_condition_en: Filing/complaint in → risk tier → mandatory review → disclose/refer.
fields.service_flow_zh: 接入 → 分级 → 复核 → 公示/转办。
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 数据缺失转人工核查；误报由监管复核。
fields.failure_degradation_en: On missing data: manual check; false positives reviewed by regulator.
fields.measurable_kpi_zh: 合规率、公示时效、投诉闭环率。
fields.measurable_kpi_en: Compliance rate, disclosure timeliness, complaint closure rate.
fields.spatial_facility_en: Governance corridor, disclosure screens, hearing corner.

fields.data_input_zh: 经登记的公开字段目录、合规样本。
fields.system_boundary_zh: 撮合与演示，原始数据不出现场；权属以登记为准。
fields.system_boundary_en: Matchmaking & demo; raw data absent on-site; ownership per registry.
fields.model_capability_zh: 字段匹配、价值评估、合规校验。
fields.model_capability_en: Field matching, value assessment, compliance check.
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 供需提交 → 沙箱撮合 → 异常人工复核。
fields.trigger_condition_en: Supply/demand submit → sandbox match → anomaly human review.
fields.service_flow_zh: 登记 → 撮合 → 签约（链上）→ 交割。
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 权属争议暂停并转仲裁；泄露熔断。
fields.failure_degradation_en: On ownership dispute: pause + arbitration; leak → circuit-break.
fields.spatial_facility_zh: 数据剧场、沙箱舱、签约区。
fields.spatial_facility_en: Data theatre, sandbox pod, signing zone.

cards.privacy_boundary_zh: 沙箱隔离；只读脱敏接口

fields.data_input_zh: 模拟城市运行数据 + 受控真实接口（只读、脱敏）。
fields.data_input_en: Simulated city ops data + controlled real interfaces (read-only, desensitized).
fields.system_boundary_zh: 沙箱内运行，禁止越权控制真实基础设施；所有写操作需人工授权。
fields.system_boundary_en: Runs in sandbox; forbids unauthorized control of real infrastructure; all writes need human authorization.
fields.model_capability_zh: 多智能体编排、仿真推演、策略回放。
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 治理/企业提交沙盒实验 → 人工复核（必）→ 授权沙箱环境。
fields.trigger_condition_en: Governance/enterprise submits experiment → mandatory review → authorized sandbox.
fields.service_flow_zh: 场景建模 → 仿真 → 策略评估 → 人工确认 → 仅以报告形式输出建议。
fields.service_flow_en: Model → simulate → assess → human confirm → report-only recommendations.
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 越权请求一律拒绝并告警；仿真失稳自动暂停；输出不可直接联动物理系统。
fields.failure_degradation_en: Unauthorized requests rejected + alerted; unstable sim auto-pauses; output never directly drives physical systems.
fields.measurable_kpi_zh: 越权拦截率 100%；仿真与历史回放误差 ≤ 10%；建议采纳前人工确认率 100%。
fields.measurable_kpi_en: Unauthorized-intercept 100%; sim vs replay error ≤ 10%; pre-adoption human-confirm 100%.
fields.spatial_facility_zh: 沙盒机房、治理协同室、可视化推演厅。
fields.spatial_facility_en: Sandbox room, governance war-room, visualization hall.

cards.reproducible_protocol_zh: 基线 = 固定历史回放数据集；记录策略版本与随机种子；保存期限 = 实验数据脱敏留存 90 天；人工决策点 = 任一写操作前授权；退出机制 = 实验结束即销毁沙箱。
cards.reproducible_protocol_en: Baseline = fixed historical replay set; log policy version & seed; retention = desensitized data 90 days; human gate = pre-write authorization; exit = destroy sandbox on finish.

fields.data_input_zh: 脱敏学习行为、课程反馈。
fields.system_boundary_zh: 个性化助学，不评测排名；未成年数据专项保护。
fields.system_boundary_en: Personalized tutoring; no ranking; minor-data special protection.
fields.model_capability_zh: 学习路径推荐、答疑、助学预警。
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 授权入学 → 行为采集 → 异常人工介入。
fields.trigger_condition_en: Authorized enrollment → behavior collect → anomaly human intervene.
fields.service_flow_zh: 授权 → 推荐 → 辅导 → 反馈。
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 推荐失效转教师人工；隐私争议退出销毁。
fields.failure_degradation_en: On rec failure: teacher fallback; privacy dispute → exit & destroy.

cards.privacy_boundary_zh: 案件脱敏；律师—当事人隔离

fields.data_input_zh: 授权案件摘要、法规库（公开）。
fields.data_input_en: Authorized case summary, public legal corpus.
fields.system_boundary_zh: 提供咨询与文书辅助，不替代律师；法律结论须执业律师确认。
fields.system_boundary_en: Consulting & drafting aid; not a substitute for lawyers; legal conclusions need licensed attorney.
fields.model_capability_zh: 法规检索、文书生成、风险告知。
fields.model_capability_en: Statute retrieval, document generation, risk notice.
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 授权咨询 → 生成草稿 → 律师复核（必）。
fields.service_flow_zh: 授权 → 检索 → 草稿 → 律师确认 → 交付。
fields.service_flow_en: Authorize → retrieve → draft → attorney confirm → deliver.
fields.failure_degradation_zh: 超范围转人工律师；误法由执业律师纠偏。
fields.failure_degradation_en: Out-of-scope → human attorney; legal errors corrected by licensed lawyer.

cards.privacy_boundary_zh: 行程授权；位置最小必要

fields.data_input_zh: 授权行程、无障碍设施台账、实时占用。
fields.data_input_en: Authorized trips, accessibility inventory, real-time occupancy.
fields.system_boundary_zh: 导航与预约辅助，不控制交通工具；位置数据最小必要、可关。
fields.system_boundary_en: Navigation & booking aid; no control of vehicles; location minimal-necessary, can disable.
fields.model_capability_zh: 无障碍路径规划、设施预约、陪伴提醒。
fields.model_capability_en: Accessible routing, facility booking, companion reminder.
fields.trigger_condition_zh: 用户授权行程 → 实时规划 → 异常人工协助。
fields.trigger_condition_en: User authorizes trip → real-time plan → anomaly human assist.
fields.service_flow_zh: 授权 → 规划 → 预约 → 陪同/兜底。
